---
title: "API examples"
description: "Explore MGnify studies, analyses and results with Python and R."
---

Find a study, list its analyses, and load a Pfam result into a data frame.
Choose an example to get started:

- [Python with requests and pandas](python.qmd) — edit and run in your browser.
- [R with jsonlite](r.qmd) — edit and run in your browser.
- [Python with MGnipy](mgnipy.qmd) — copy and run in your own Python environment.

The examples start with [an Antarctic soil assembly study](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/metagenomics/studies/MGYS00010393/overview). Enter another study
accession at the top of either page to explore your own data.
